title: MZ VisuStella Message Core and EliMZ Message Manager conflict

posts.author: Cicadawing
posts.body:
Currently using message core and am running into a conflict with my plugins. I'm using EliMZ's plugin that allows me to reposition the text box to other places in the screen, as shown in the first screenshot, but if I happen to display choices right after using that effect the choices are also tied to that corner of the screen, which I do not want. However, if i don't use that plugin, the choices are placed in the upper right corner of the screen, where I (with the help of another plugin) want/specified them to be.
I did some testing, and I can confirm that it is the Message Core plugin that's causing this to happen. The main reason why I want to keep that plugin is because it includes large choices, but also large choices with a scroll wheel, which is a life-saver for me since a lot of my game is going to be choice-based. Other plugins (such as HimeWork's large choices plugin) don't have a scroll bar, or at least when I use them they don't.
Any suggestions on how to fix this would be greatly appreciated, or other large choices plugins I can use in replacement to VisuStella's plugin. Thank you!!

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
It's a bit unclear to me what you're trying to do, but you can use VS message core to change the message window size and placement (there's plugin commands and text codes for that).
I don't think it freely allows you to position the choice window, but if you're showing the choice window without showing the message at the same time (like in your pics), you can at least fake it. Like before showing the choices use the plugin commands to change the message window size (you can control choice window x-coordinate like this) and then use the plugin command 'Choices: Distance' to control the y-coordinate. If you're not showing the message window at the same time, you can give it any width like full screen for example and set the choice position left/right to have it at the edges. Then just after the choice, set the message window properties back to whatever you want before showing messages.
